name: The Tear of the Moons
summary: At Bael Modan, Feegly the Exiled still begs for the Tear of the Moons, the relic that drove him mad.

sections.title: Unearthed at Bael Modan
sections.body: Dwarves found the Tear of the Moons while cutting into the southern Kalimdor hills for Bael Modan. It was the expedition’s first major discovery. Its strange influence fell at once on Feegly, one of the workers.

sections.title: Twinbraid's Quarantine
sections.body: Feegly claimed the Tear gave him immense power. He turned violently on his comrades to protect it. General Twinbraid saw the relic’s corrupting hold, called it cursed, took it from Feegly, and locked it in the keep. Banished from the excavation camp, Feegly took refuge among the cliffs. Bitter and obsessed, he begs passing travelers to steal the Tear back.

sections.title: The Terrible Cost
sections.body: General Twinbraid’s warnings prove true when Feegly recovers the Tear of the Moons. Its hidden transformative magic consumes him and changes the dwarf into a feral trogg. Seconds after reclaiming the prize, Feegly dies.

faq.q: What is the Tear of the Moons?
aliases: what is tear of the moons
faq.answer: The Tear of the Moons is a potent relic found by dwarven excavators during their early digs at Bael Modan in the southern Barrens. It corrupts those who handle it and fills them with an intoxicating desire for power.
Feegly the Exiled was an excavator with General Twinbraid’s expedition at Bael Modan. After the Tear of the Moons was found, he grew obsessed and violent. Twinbraid cast him out of the keep.

faq.q: Why does General Twinbraid lock the Tear away?
faq.answer: General Twinbraid locked the Tear away because he recognized it as a dangerous curse. After Feegly turned on his fellow excavators, Twinbraid secured the relic inside Bael Modan’s keep.

faq.q: What happens when you return the Tear to Feegly?
faq.answer: Returning the Tear satisfies Feegly’s demand, but what follows is not yet known.

faq.q: Is the Tear's magic fully understood?
faq.answer: General Twinbraid calls the Tear cursed, while Feegly craves the power he believes it grants. Its magic remains unexplained.

faq.q: Why is this a Horde quest if Feegly is a dwarf?
faq.answer: Feegly is an outcast hiding in the Barrens, where he despises the Alliance forces occupying Bael Modan. He appeals to Horde adventurers, hostile to Twinbraid’s excavation, to raid the keep and recover the relic.

angles.text: Striking Bael Modan to recover the relic gives the Horde a chance to disrupt dwarven operations that infringe on the Barrens.
